title: fix(ui): remove ellipsis from queued-turn status
body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes the literal ellipsis shown in “Waiting for turn to start…” while a chat turn is queued, restoring the punctuation cleanup already applied to the response-wait label.

## User Impact

Queued turns show “Waiting for turn to start” without the trailing ellipsis, matching the response-wait label. Queue behavior, elapsed time, and other startup labels are unchanged.

## Why This Change Was Made

Correct the canonical English label and update existing test expectations, with one regression assertion rejecting the ellipsis. Generated translations and locale metadata are intentionally unchanged; the normal post-merge locale workflow owns their refresh.

## Evidence

- Regression proof on the original English source: one expected failure (the rendered queued status still contained the ellipsis), eight passes; 37.07 seconds wall time. With the fix: nine unit tests passed in 7.45 seconds.
- Seven relevant browser checks across five files passed in 31.27 seconds, covering startup waits, continuing runs, elapsed-time ordering, next-turn status, and plugin branding. Fifteen unrelated cases were intentionally filtered.
- The final uninstrumented queued-flow suite passed both cases in 29.67 seconds, including a 23.64-second production UI bundle build.
- UI typecheck, keyless i18n baseline/verification, targeted lint, formatting, and `git diff --check` passed. The raw-copy baseline did not change.
- Isolated shared-helper autoreview completed with no P0 findings on the exact patch; validation was run separately, not by the reviewer.
- [Exact-head PR CI](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/40423763585): passed; 668s run wall time and 5234s aggregate non-skipped job time (parallel jobs counted separately).

Actual bundled Control UI, existing restored-queued-run fixture, light theme, synthetic content, and a fixed clock; inspected before/after crops from matched 1200×800 viewport captures:

### Before

![Queued-turn status before the fix, with a trailing ellipsis](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/f4f9b797-cb37-4bfe-b13d-003f9529862a)

### After

![Queued-turn status after the fix, without a trailing ellipsis](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/2f678b97-475f-40b7-bea0-7960781c52c0)

Requested by @Patrick-Erichsen.
